description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories, labeled 'tag,' and includes case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect,' ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, distinguished by specific colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the 'case' category, mBERT-L₂ consistently exhibits the highest effect, with values exceeding 15, while XLM-B₂ shows the lowest effect, remaining below 5. The 'tense' category demonstrates a steady decline across all models, with values approaching zero. Error bars indicate the standard deviation, with the largest variability observed in the 'gender' category across all models.
